Maya (CSM): Quick kickoff for Calyx Health Systems — they signed yesterday and want an internal demo in two weeks. Need to align stakeholders, concrete success criteria, and a practical 30-day rollout. Proposed: Wed 11:00am PT. Context: PHI-sensitive, require SSO (SAML), KMS integration, demo latency target ~<300ms for short prompts.

Priya (Account Exec): Contract's executed. Renewal risk low but legal requested SOC2 artifacts and vendor questionnaire before broader rollout. I'll surface that in the kickoff.

Ethan (Success Eng): I'll own the tech runbook. Pre-kickoff asks: confirm network connectivity preference (VPC peering vs VPN), desired KMS key policy, and whether they want Redwood Private or Dedicated for the pilot. Smoke test estimate: within 5 business days after access.

Maya (CSM): Stakeholder list (please confirm):
- Jules (Calyx PM) — product lead, day-to-day contact
- Dr. Rivera (Calyx Data Lead) — model/quality owner (will join demos)
- Priya (Account Exec) — contract & renewal owner
- Ethan (Success Eng) — Redwood technical lead
- Maya (CSM) — onboarding project lead

Candidate success criteria:
1) Secure demo: SSO + demo conversation p50 <300ms, p95 <600ms for short clinical prompts
2) Data control: KMS integrated and access patterns documented
3) Integration: prefix/KV caching operational for expected prompt shapes
4) Enablement: two power-users trained and a runnable failover runbook

Ethan (Success Eng): Minimal initial checklist (will put in Confluence):
```
- Confirm network path (VPC peering / VPN)
- Provision service account + RBAC
- Configure KMS, verify key rotation
- Deploy demo model (quantized variant) to dedicated pool
- Run perf smoke tests: 50 requests, gather p50/p95
```

Jules (Calyx PM): Wed 11am PT works better for our clinicians. Who will lead the power-user enablement?

Maya (CSM): Redwood can run the enablement session; Priya can cover contract/SLA items during that hour. I'll schedule a 60-min training after the demo.

Priya (Account Exec): Confirmed — Jules and Dr. Rivera will join kickoff. I'll pull SOC2 artifacts and the vendor questionnaire by EOD Monday and flag any legal blockers.

onboard-bot: task CALYX-001 created: "Initial access & network checklist" assigned to Ethan, due 5 business days after kickoff. :white_check_mark:

Ethan (Success Eng): Thanks. Jules, please share VPC ranges and the initial prompt set so I can run perf sims.

Jules (Calyx PM): Uploaded prompts to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.example/calyx/prompts (internal). Also added a sample CSV of expected conversational lengths.

Maya (CSM): Owners recap:
- Kickoff: Wed 11:00am PT (invite sent) — Maya/Priya/Ethan/Jules/Dr. Rivera
- Network & KMS: Ethan (owner) — CALYX-001
- Legal/SOC2 artifacts: Priya (owner)
- Demo prompt + perf validation: Jules + Ethan
- Enablement & training: Maya to schedule, Priya to speak on SLAs

Risks: If KMS/SSO not provisioned by Day 7 the demo will need to be rescheduled, which could increase friction before first monthly review — flagging for Exec attention if access not provided on time.

Priya (Account Exec): I'll escalate to legal now and request SOC2 artifact list by EOD Monday.

Maya (CSM): Thanks all — I'll post the kickoff agenda and share meeting notes after the session. :party:
